verdict.rationale: A probe found a live llms.txt at support.elicit.com that indexes the Elicit Help Center for agents, and Elicit also serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec at the docs root, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. Coverage is limited because the llms.txt covers only help-center articles and is not advertised in first-party docs. The API docs have no llms.txt, and the docs-root markdown probe returned 404. missing for 10: llms.txt or llms-full.txt for the API reference (docs.elicit.com), first-party documentation advertising agent-oriented docs, a working docs-root markdown endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://support.elicit.com/llms.txt # Elicit Help Center

Elicit serves a full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Elicit API", version 2.0.0; 46 paths across Search, Sessions, Reports, Systematic Reviews, Research Agent and more; server https://elicit.com/api/v2)
